heroDescription: Family guesthouse 'Zatoka Getaway'. Cozy yard with BBQ zone, kids playground, shared kitchen, air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and free parking. Just a 5-minute walk to the beach.
welcomeDesc: Our cozy family guesthouse is located in a quiet area of Zatoka, just a 5-minute walk from the sandy beach. We offer comfortable rooms with all essential amenities (AC, Wi-Fi, private bathroom), a green yard with a BBQ area, a kids playground, and a shared kitchen. It is the perfect place for a relaxed and warm family holiday.

aboutDesc: Discover the story of "Zatoka Getaway" guesthouse and the people who care about your comfort.
storyDesc1: Founded in 2016, our guesthouse was born from a desire to create a cozy place for affordable family vacations in Zatoka. We are a family-run business, and we wanted to make a place where everyone feels like a welcomed friend.
storyDesc2: Over the years, we have built comfortable rooms with private bathrooms, planted a beautiful green garden, set up a BBQ area and a playground, keeping the warm family welcome and care for every guest.
missionDesc: To provide a comfortable, warm, and affordable vacation for the whole family, surrounding every guest with care and attention.
